<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@500;700;800&family=Onest:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style id="vk-css">
.vk{--bg: #11131b;
  --panel: #171a24;
  --tile: #1c2030;
  --line: rgba(247, 245, 241, .09);
  --line-hi: rgba(247, 245, 241, .2);
  --fg: #f7f5f1;
  --muted: #a7a39a;
  --accent: #c3a15a;
  --accent-hi: #d4b673;
  --on-accent: #11131b;
  --ok: #c3a15a;
  --bar: rgba(17, 19, 27, .92);

  --f-display: "Unbounded", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --f-text: "Onest", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;

  --r: 5px;
  --gap: 10px;
  --m: clamp(16px, 3.4vw, 48px);
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);}
.vk *, .vk *::before, .vk *::after{box-sizing: border-box;}
.vk{margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--f-text); overflow-x: hidden;}
.vk img{display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto;}
.vk a{color: inherit;}
.vk p, .vk h1, .vk h2, .vk h3, .vk figure, .vk dl, .vk dd{margin: 0;}
.vk button{font: inherit; color: inherit;}
.vk :focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}
.vk .skip{position: absolute; left: -999px; top: 8px; z-index: 100; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); padding: 10px 14px;}
.vk .skip:focus{left: 8px;}
.vk .mono{font: 500 .75rem/1.4 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);}
.vk .acc{color: var(--accent);}
.vk .btn{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
  font: 600 .95rem/1 var(--f-text); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s, transform .35s var(--ease);}
.vk .btn:hover{background: var(--accent-hi); border-color: var(--accent-hi);}
.vk .btn:active{transform: scale(.98);}
.vk .btn--sm{min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: .875rem;}
.vk .btn--wide{width: 100%;}
.vk .btn--ghost{background: transparent; color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--line-hi);}
.vk .btn--ghost:hover{background: transparent; border-color: var(--fg);}
.vk .top{position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px;
  padding: 14px var(--m); background: var(--bar); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(10px); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(10px);}
.vk .logo{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; font: 700 .72rem/1.1 var(--f-display); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em;}
.vk .logo__mark{display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent); border-radius: var(--r); font: 800 1rem/1 var(--f-display);}
.vk .nav{display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-left: auto; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--muted);}
.vk .nav a{text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s;}
.vk .nav a:hover{color: var(--fg);}
.vk .lic{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 .72rem/1 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);}
.vk .lic i{width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(195, 161, 90, .18);}
.vk .theme-link{font: 500 .72rem/1 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--line-hi); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 9px 10px; transition: color .2s, border-color .2s;}
.vk .theme-link:hover{color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--fg);}
.vk.vk--light{--bg: #f7f5f1;
  --panel: #efe9df;
  --tile: #ffffff;
  --line: rgba(17, 19, 27, .10);
  --line-hi: rgba(17, 19, 27, .22);
  --fg: #11131b;
  --muted: #62605c;
  --accent: #c3a15a;
  --accent-hi: #b08f4c;
  --on-accent: #11131b;
  --bar: rgba(247, 245, 241, .92);}
.vk.vk--light .acc{color: #a9853f;}
.vk.vk--light .lic i{box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(195, 161, 90, .25);}
.vk .hero{padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 56px) var(--m) var(--gap);}
.vk .coord{font: 500 .72rem/1.4 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);}
.vk .mega{margin: clamp(18px, 2.4vw, 32px) 0 clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); font-family: var(--f-display); text-transform: uppercase; line-height: .9;}
.vk .mega__l1{display: block; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 800; font-size: min(13.2vw, 13rem); letter-spacing: -.055em;}
.vk .mega__l2{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2vw; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.4vw, 4.4rem); letter-spacing: -.035em; color: var(--muted); margin-top: .12em;}
.vk .mega__l2 > span:first-child{white-space: nowrap;}
.vk .mega__dash{flex: 1; height: 3px; background: var(--accent); min-width: 40px;}
.vk .bento{display: grid; gap: var(--gap);}
.vk .bento--hero{grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto auto;}
.vk .tile--hero{grid-row: span 2; min-height: 460px;}
.vk .tile{position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tile); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r);
  padding: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 26px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;}
.vk .tile__big{font: 800 clamp(2.4rem, 3.8vw, 4rem)/1 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.05em; margin-top: auto; white-space: nowrap;}
.vk .tile__mid{font: 700 clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem)/1.2 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.02em; text-transform: uppercase;}
.vk .tile__sub{color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem;}
.vk .tile--photo{padding: 0; background: #0c0e14;}
.vk .tile--photo > img{position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;}
.vk .tile--photo figcaption{position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: 14px; color: #f7f5f1; background: rgba(17, 19, 27, .72); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--r); max-width: calc(100% - 28px);}
.vk .tile--cta{background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); text-decoration: none; justify-content: flex-end; min-height: 200px;}
.vk .tile--cta .mono{color: rgba(17, 19, 27, .7);}
.vk .tile--cta .tile__mid{font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2vw, 1.9rem); max-width: 12ch;}
.vk .tile__arrow{position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 20px; font: 700 1.6rem/1 var(--f-display); transition: transform .35s var(--ease);}
.vk .tile--cta:hover .tile__arrow{transform: translate(4px, -4px);}
.vk .tile--link{text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color .2s;}
.vk .tile--link:hover{border-color: var(--accent);}
.vk .tile__more{display: inline-block; color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent); text-underline-offset: 4px;}
.vk .tile--link:hover .tile__more{color: var(--accent);}
.vk .ticker{overflow: hidden; border-block: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); padding: 22px 0; margin-top: calc(var(--gap) * 2);}
.vk .ticker__track{display: flex; width: max-content; will-change: transform;}
.vk .ticker span{font: 800 clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 3vw, 4.2rem)/1 var(--f-display); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -.035em; padding-right: .6em; white-space: nowrap;}
.vk .ticker span i{font-style: normal; color: var(--accent); padding-left: .6em;}
.vk .sec{padding: clamp(72px, 9vw, 128px) var(--m);}
.vk .sec--panel{background: var(--panel); border-block: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .sec:not(.sec--panel) + .sec:not(.sec--panel), .vk .sec:not(.sec--panel) + .book{padding-top: 0;}
.vk .sec__head{display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 48px); max-width: 980px;}
.vk .h2{font: 800 clamp(2rem, 5.4vw, 4.6rem)/.95 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.045em; text-transform: uppercase;}
.vk .lead{color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.0625rem; max-width: 56ch;}
.vk .note{margin-top: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .875rem;}
.vk .bento--three{grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));}
.vk .path{min-height: 440px; gap: 12px;}
.vk .path__name{font: 800 clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 3rem)/1 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.045em; text-transform: uppercase;}
.vk .path .tile__sub{max-width: 34ch;}
.vk .kv{margin-top: auto; display: grid; gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .kv div{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .kv dt{font: 500 .72rem/1.6 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);}
.vk .kv dd{font-weight: 500;}
.vk .path--img{color: #f7f5f1;}
.vk .path--img::before{content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: rgba(12, 14, 20, .68);}
.vk .path__body{position: relative; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; height: 100%; padding: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 26px);}
.vk .path--img .tile__sub, .vk .path--img .mono, .vk .path--img dt{color: #d9d5cc;}
.vk .path--img .kv, .vk .path--img .kv div{border-color: rgba(247, 245, 241, .18);}
.vk .visit{display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--gap);}
.vk .visit__photo{min-height: 520px;}
.vk .steps{list-style: none; margin: 0; gap: 0; padding-block: 8px;}
.vk .steps li{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr; gap: 14px; padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .steps li:last-child{border-bottom: 0;}
.vk .steps li > .mono{color: var(--accent); padding-top: 4px;}
.vk .steps strong{display: block; font: 700 1.15rem/1.2 var(--f-display); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-bottom: 6px;}
.vk .steps p{color: var(--muted); max-width: 52ch;}
.vk .work{display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 440px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--gap); align-items: stretch;}
.vk .work__side{display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--gap);}
.vk .work__cta{flex: 1; min-height: 120px;}
.vk .proof{gap: 12px;}
.vk .proof__list{font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 12px;}
.vk .ba{padding: 0; min-height: 550px; align-self: stretch; user-select: none; background: #0c0e14;}
.vk .ba img, .vk .ba__before{position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;}
.vk .ba__before{clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--pos)) 0 0);}
.vk .ba__before img{width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;}
.vk .ba::after{content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: var(--pos); width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--accent); pointer-events: none; z-index: 2;}
.vk .ba__tag{position: absolute; top: 14px; z-index: 3; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--r); background: rgba(17, 19, 27, .78); color: #f7f5f1;}
.vk .ba__tag--l{left: 14px;}
.vk .ba__tag--r{right: 14px;}
.vk .ba__handle{position: absolute; z-index: 3; top: 50%; left: var(--pos); width: 48px; height: 48px; margin: -24px 0 0 -24px; border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; pointer-events: none;}
.vk .ba__range{position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 4; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: ew-resize;}
.vk .ba:focus-within{outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}
.vk .sec__head--row{display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 24px; max-width: none; flex-wrap: wrap;}
.vk .sec__head--row > div:first-child{display: grid; gap: 14px;}
.vk .rv__nav{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;}
.vk .rv__all{margin-right: 10px; color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent); text-underline-offset: 5px;}
.vk .rv__all:hover{color: var(--accent);}
.vk .rv__btn{width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: var(--r); border: 1px solid var(--line-hi); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1rem; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s, color .2s;}
.vk .rv__btn:hover{border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent);}
.vk .rv__row{display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(300px, calc((100% - 3 * var(--gap)) / 3.4)); gap: var(--gap); overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; touch-action: pan-x pan-y; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 4px; cursor: grab;}
.vk .rv__row.is-drag{cursor: grabbing; scroll-snap-type: none;}
.vk .rv__row.is-drag .rv{pointer-events: none;}
.vk .rv__row::-webkit-scrollbar{display: none;}
.vk .rv{scroll-snap-align: start; gap: 16px; min-height: 300px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s; -webkit-user-drag: none;}
.vk .rv:hover{border-color: var(--accent);}
.vk .rv__stars{display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .12em; font-size: 1.05rem;}
.vk .rv__stars .mono{letter-spacing: .08em;}
.vk .rv__off{color: var(--line-hi);}
.vk .rv__text{margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.55; flex: 1; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 7; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;}
.vk .rv__who{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .rv__who strong{font-weight: 600;}
.vk .rv__ava{display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: 700 .8rem/1 var(--f-display);}
@media (max-width: 640px){.vk .rv__row{grid-auto-columns: 86%;}
.vk .rv__nav{flex-wrap: wrap;}
.vk .rv__btn{display: none;}}
.vk .faq{display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap); align-items: start;}
.vk .faq details{padding: 0;}
.vk .faq summary{list-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 22px 56px 22px 22px; font: 600 1.05rem/1.35 var(--f-text); position: relative;}
.vk .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display: none;}
.vk .faq summary::after{content: "+"; position: absolute; right: 22px; top: 18px; font: 500 1.4rem/1 var(--f-mono); color: var(--accent); transition: transform .3s var(--ease);}
.vk .faq details[open] summary::after{transform: rotate(45deg);}
.vk .faq details p{padding: 0 22px 22px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 60ch;}
.vk .faq details:hover{border-color: var(--line-hi);}
.vk .book{padding: clamp(72px, 9vw, 128px) var(--m);}
.vk .book__head{display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 28px;}
.vk .book__title{font: 800 clamp(2.8rem, 11vw, 11rem)/.88 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.055em; text-transform: uppercase;}
.vk .booking{gap: 18px;}
.vk .booking__paths{border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;}
.vk .booking__paths legend{margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 0;}
.vk .booking__paths label{position: relative;}
.vk .booking__paths input{position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; cursor: pointer;}
.vk .booking__paths span{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line-hi); border-radius: var(--r); font: 700 .8rem/1 var(--f-display); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s;}
.vk .booking__paths input:checked + span{background: var(--fg); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--fg);}
.vk .booking__paths input:focus-visible + span{outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}
.vk .booking__paths label:hover span{border-color: var(--fg);}
.vk .booking__row{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1.2fr .6fr; gap: var(--gap);}
.vk .fld{display: grid; gap: 8px;}
.vk .fld input, .vk .fld textarea{width: 100%; font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--f-text); color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line-hi);
  border-radius: var(--r); padding: 13px 14px; min-height: 50px; transition: border-color .2s;}
.vk .fld input:focus, .vk .fld textarea:focus{outline: none; border-color: var(--accent);}
.vk .fld [aria-invalid="true"]{border-color: #e0715f;}
.vk .booking__send{display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px;}
.vk .form-status{flex-basis: 100%; min-height: 1.4em; color: var(--fg);}
.vk .book__call{display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; margin-top: 28px;}
.vk .book__call a{font: 800 clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3.2rem)/1 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -.04em; text-decoration: none;}
.vk .book__call a:hover{color: var(--accent);}
.vk .foot{display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px 32px; padding: 28px var(--m) 32px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);}
.vk .foot .logo{margin-right: auto;}
.vk .foot a{color: var(--muted);}
.vk .foot a:hover{color: var(--fg);}
.vk .mobile-cta{display: none;}
@media (max-width: 1100px){.vk .nav{display: none;}
.vk .lic{margin-left: auto;}
.vk .bento--hero{grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;}
.vk .tile--hero{grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: auto; min-height: 380px;}
.vk .bento--three{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
.vk .path{min-height: 0;}
.vk .path--img{min-height: 420px;}
.vk .visit, .vk .work{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
.vk .ba{max-width: 520px; width: 100%; min-height: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;}
.vk .visit__photo{min-height: 0; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;}
.vk .faq{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}}
@media (max-width: 640px){.vk .lic{display: none;}
.vk .top{gap: 10px;}
.vk .logo > span:last-child{display: none;}
.vk .theme-link{padding: 9px 8px; margin-left: auto;}
.vk .top .btn{margin-left: 0 !important;}
.vk .top .btn{margin-left: auto;}
.vk .bento--hero{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
.vk .tile--hero{min-height: 300px;}
.vk .tile--cta{min-height: 150px;}
.vk .mega__l2{font-size: 6.2vw;}
.vk .kv div{grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr;}
.vk .booking__row{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
.vk .book__call{flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;}
.vk .foot{padding-bottom: 96px;}
.vk .mobile-cta{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 70; padding: 10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: var(--bar); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); transform: translateY(110%); transition: transform .4s var(--ease);}
.vk .mobile-cta.show{transform: none;}}
.vk .progress{position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; z-index: 80; pointer-events: none;}
.vk .progress span{display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transform-origin: 0 50%; transform: scaleX(var(--p, 0));}
.vk.m .mega__l1{overflow: hidden; padding-bottom: .04em;}
.vk.m .mega__l1 .ch{display: inline-block; transform: translateY(108%); animation: rise .9s var(--ease) forwards; animation-delay: calc(120ms + var(--i) * 45ms);}
.vk.m .mega__l2 > span:first-child{opacity: 0; animation: fade .8s ease forwards .55s;}
.vk.m .mega__dash{transform-origin: 0 50%; transform: scaleX(0); animation: draw 1.2s var(--ease) forwards .7s;}
.vk.m .coord{opacity: 0; animation: fade .8s ease forwards .05s;}
.vk.m .tile--hero img{animation: settle 1.8s var(--ease) both .2s;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > *{opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); animation: up .9s var(--ease) forwards;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > :nth-child(1){animation-delay: .35s;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > :nth-child(2){animation-delay: .47s;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > :nth-child(3){animation-delay: .57s;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > :nth-child(4){animation-delay: .67s;}
.vk.m .bento--hero > :nth-child(5){animation-delay: .77s;}
@keyframes rise{ to { transform: none; } }
@keyframes fade{ to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes draw{ to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
@keyframes up{ to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes settle{ from { transform: scale(1.14); filter: brightness(.6); } }
.vk.m [data-in]{opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); transition: opacity .8s ease, transform .9s var(--ease); transition-delay: calc(var(--d, 0) * 70ms);}
.vk.m [data-in].in{opacity: 1; transform: none;}
.vk.m .h2[data-in]{clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateY(18px); transition: clip-path 1s var(--ease), transform 1s var(--ease), opacity .6s;}
.vk.m .h2[data-in].in{clip-path: inset(0 0 -10% 0);}
.vk .tile{--mx: 50%; --my: 50%;}
.vk .tile::after{content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 3; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .35s ease;
  background: radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx) var(--my), rgba(195, 161, 90, .10), transparent 45%);}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
/* Vanta Surfaces — kitchen renovation landing.

   decorative motion runs only without "reduce motion" (class .m on <html>). */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var root = document.querySelector('.vk');
  if (!root) return;
  var reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var fine = matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;

  /* Lead endpoint: define window.VANTA_FORM_ENDPOINT before this script to POST JSON.
     Without it the form opens a pre-filled email to the office. */

  /* ── Before / after ── */
  var ba = document.querySelector('.ba');
  if (ba) {
    var range = ba.querySelector('.ba__range');
    range.addEventListener('input', function () { ba.style.setProperty('--pos', range.value + '%'); });
  }

  /* ── Reviews row arrows ── */
  var rvRow = document.querySelector('.rv__row');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv]').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var card = rvRow.querySelector('.rv');
      var step = card ? card.getBoundingClientRect().width + 10 : 320;
      rvRow.scrollBy({ left: step * +b.dataset.rv, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    });
  });

  /* Drag the reviews row with a mouse (touch scrolls natively); a drag never counts as a click */
  if (rvRow) {
    var down = false, moved = false, sx = 0, sl = 0;
    rvRow.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || e.button !== 0) return;
      down = true; moved = false; sx = e.clientX; sl = rvRow.scrollLeft;
    });
    addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (!down) return;
      var dx = e.clientX - sx;
      if (!moved && Math.abs(dx) > 6) { moved = true; rvRow.classList.add('is-drag'); }
      if (moved) rvRow.scrollLeft = sl - dx;
    });
    addEventListener('pointerup', function () {
      if (!down) return;
      down = false;
      if (moved) setTimeout(function () { rvRow.classList.remove('is-drag'); }, 0);
    });
    rvRow.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (moved) { e.preventDefault(); moved = false; } }, true);
    rvRow.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  }

  /* ── Mobile sticky call-to-action ── */
  var mc = document.querySelector('.mobile-cta'), hero = document.querySelector('.hero'), book = document.getElementById('vanta-estimate-form') || document.getElementById('book');
  if (mc && hero && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var heroIn = true, bookIn = false;
    var upd = function () { mc.classList.toggle('show', !heroIn && !bookIn); };
    new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { heroIn = e[0].isIntersecting; upd(); }).observe(hero);
    if (book) new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { bookIn = e[0].isIntersecting; upd(); }).observe(book);
  }

  if (reduce) return;
  root.classList.add('m');

  /* ── Letters of the big word rise one by one ── */
  var l1 = document.querySelector('.mega__l1');
  if (l1) {
    l1.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    l1.innerHTML = l1.textContent.split('').map(function (c, i) {
      return '<span class="ch" style="--i:' + i + '">' + (c === ' ' ? ' ' : c) + '</span>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── Scroll progress bar ── */
  var bar = document.createElement('div');
  bar.className = 'progress';
  bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  bar.innerHTML = '<span></span>';
  root.prepend(bar);

  /* ── Reveal on scroll, staggered inside each group ── */
  var targets = '.sec__head > *, .bento--three > .tile, .visit > *, .steps li, .work > *, .work__side > *, .rv, .faq > *, .book__head > *, .booking, .book__call, .note';
  var groups = new Map();
  document.querySelectorAll(targets).forEach(function (el) {
    var p = el.parentElement, n = groups.get(p) || 0;
    groups.set(p, n + 1);
    el.setAttribute('data-in', '');
    el.style.setProperty('--d', Math.min(n, 8));
  });
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
    es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-in]').forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });

  /* ── Ticker speeds up with scroll velocity; progress; fallback reveal after anchor jumps ── */
  var track = document.querySelector('.ticker__track'), tickerAnim = null;
  if (track && track.animate) {
    track.innerHTML += track.innerHTML;
    tickerAnim = track.animate([{ transform: 'translateX(0)' }, { transform: 'translateX(-50%)' }], { duration: 38000, iterations: Infinity });
  }
  var lastY = scrollY, lastT = performance.now(), boost = 1, ticking = false;
  var frame = function () {
    ticking = false;
    var max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight;
    bar.style.setProperty('--p', max > 0 ? (scrollY / max).toFixed(4) : 0);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-in]:not(.in)').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.getBoundingClientRect().top < innerHeight * 0.92) { el.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(el); }
    });
  };
  addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    var t = performance.now(), dy = Math.abs(scrollY - lastY) / Math.max(16, t - lastT);
    lastY = scrollY; lastT = t;
    boost = Math.min(6, 1 + dy * 4);
    if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  }, { passive: true });
  if (tickerAnim) {
    (function decay() {
      tickerAnim.playbackRate += (boost - tickerAnim.playbackRate) * 0.12;
      boost += (1 - boost) * 0.06;
      requestAnimationFrame(decay);
    })();
  }
  frame();

  /* ── Spotlight and magnetic buttons (precise pointers only) ── */
  if (fine) {
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      var t = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tile');
      if (!t) return;
      var r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
      t.style.setProperty('--mx', (e.clientX - r.left) + 'px');
      t.style.setProperty('--my', (e.clientY - r.top) + 'px');
    }, { passive: true });
    document.querySelectorAll('.tile--cta, .top .btn, .booking .btn').forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.add('magnet');
      b.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
        var r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
        var x = (e.clientX - r.left - r.width / 2) / r.width, y = (e.clientY - r.top - r.height / 2) / r.height;
        b.style.transform = 'translate(' + (x * 8).toFixed(1) + 'px,' + (y * 6).toFixed(1) + 'px)';
      });
      b.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { b.style.transform = ''; });
    });
  }

})();

05 / Questions

Asked before every estimate

Can I remodel without changing the layout?

Yes. Keeping the layout reduces cost and time. We replace cabinets, counters, backsplash, flooring and lighting while plumbing and appliances stay put.

Do I need board approval in a co-op or condo?

For most work beyond a refresh, yes. We prepare the alteration paperwork, COI and work schedule your building asks for and coordinate with the managing agent.

Can you work in a small or galley kitchen?

Yes. Compact and galley kitchens get space-efficient cabinetry, more storage and better lighting without unnecessary structural work.

Can I change the layout?

Often, depending on plumbing, electrical, structure and building rules. We review the change and coordinate licensed trades and permits.

Do you work on rental units?

Yes. We work with landlords and property managers, planning cabinets, counters, flooring, paint and fixtures around turnover dates.

What do you need for an estimate?

The address, photos of the kitchen, rough measurements and what you want changed. A budget range or material ideas help too.
